spec.name: M6.ActualCSS.J_dot
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v w : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), M6.Character.dot (M6.Flatten.J N v) (M6.Flatten.J N w) = M6.Character.dot v w
spec.guidance: Use flatten_dot, flatten_left/right and explicit Physical.J index reversal; finite sum over ZMod N is invariant under negation. This proves the actual J isometry, not an assumption. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
